• High fiscal deficits can lead to higher public debt and interest rates, impacting the economy's overall health.

questions.question: Who suggested that the origin of life must have been from simple inorganic substances?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**JBS Haldane**__

__
 
• **JBS Haldane** suggested that the origin of life must have been from simple inorganic substances.
 
• Haldane, along with Alexander Oparin, independently proposed the hypothesis of the "**primordial soup**" where life began in a warm pond with a mix of chemicals.
 
• His ideas contributed significantly to the field of abiogenesis, the study of how life on Earth could have arisen from inanimate matter.
 
• This hypothesis laid the foundation for future experimental work, such as the Miller-Urey experiment, which tested the chemical origins of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **JBS Haldane** was a British-born Indian scientist known for his works in physiology, genetics, evolutionary biology, and mathematics.
 
• He was one of the founders of the field of population genetics.
 
• Haldane's work in evolutionary biology and genetics helped bridge the gap between Darwinian evolution and Mendelian genetics.
 
• He proposed that the early Earth's atmosphere was reducing, which was essential for the chemical reactions that led to the formation of organic molecules.

questions.question: When a 24 V potential is applied across a conductor and 96 mA current is flowing through it then the resistance of the conductor is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**0.250 Ω**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The resistance of a conductor can be calculated using Ohm's Law, which states that **V = IR**, where V is the voltage, I is the current, and R is the resistance.
 
• Given that the potential difference (V) is **24 V** and the current (I) is **96 mA** (which is **0.096 A**), we can rearrange the formula to find the resistance (R).
 
• Using the formula: **R = V / I**
 
• Substitute the given values: **R = 24 V / 0.096 A**
 
• This gives us: **R = 250 Ω**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ohm's Law** is fundamental in the field of electronics and electrical engineering, allowing for the calculation of voltage, current, or resistance in a circuit.
 
• The** unit of resistance is the ohm (Ω)**, named after German physicist Georg Simon Ohm.
 
• It's important to convert all units to the standard SI units before performing calculations to ensure accuracy.

• The **73rd Amendment** pertains to the Panchayati Raj Institutions (rural local governments), while the **74th Amendment** pertains to Municipalities (urban local governments).

• The **Constitution of India** provides the framework for the division of responsibilities between these electoral bodies.

questions.question: Which of the following has the highest boiling point?

__
 
• **CaO** has the **highest boiling point** among the given options.
 
• Boiling points are influenced by the strength of the ionic bonds in the compound.
 
• CaO has a** very high lattice energy due** to the **strong ionic bond between Ca²⁺ and O²⁻**.
 
• In comparison, NaCl, LiCl, and CaCl₂ have lower boiling points because their ionic bonds are not as strong as in CaO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lattice energy** is a measure of the** strength of the forces between the ions in an ionic solid**.
 
• Higher lattice energy generally results in higher boiling points.
 
• CaO, being an oxide, has a stronger ionic bond compared to chlorides due to the higher charge of O²⁻ compared to Cl⁻.
 
• The melting and boiling points of ionic compounds are generally high due to the strong electrostatic forces between the ions.

questions.question: Which gases are evolved during complete decomposition of ferrous sulphate crystals?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both SO₂ and SO₃**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the complete decomposition of ferrous sulphate crystals, both **SO₂ (Sulfur Dioxide)** and **SO₃ (Sulfur Trioxide)** gases are evolved.
 
• Ferrous sulphate crystals (FeSO₄·7H₂O) first lose water molecules to form anhydrous ferrous sulphate (FeSO₄).
 
• Upon further heating, anhydrous ferrous sulphate decomposes to form ferric oxide (Fe2O3), sulfur dioxide (SO2), and sulfur trioxide (SO3).
 
• The chemical reaction can be summarized as follows: **2FeSO₄ → Fe₂O₃ + SO₂ + SO₃.**
 
• This reaction highlights the evolution of both SO₂ and SO₃ gases during the decomposition process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ferrous sulphate crystals** are commonly known as** green vitriol or iron vitriol**.
 
• They are used in various applications including water treatment, as a fertilizer, and in the production of other iron compounds.
 
• The decomposition process is typically carried out in a controlled environment to prevent the release of sulfur gases into the atmosphere, as they can contribute to air pollution and acid rain.
 
• Proper safety measures should be taken while handling and decomposing ferrous sulphate crystals to avoid exposure to sulfur gases.

questions.question: A 280 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 8 km/h (in same direction) in 16 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 380 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 37 km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 280 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 8 km/h (in same direction) in 16 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 380 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 37 km/h?

**Formula used:**

Relative speed in the same direction = Speed of train - Speed of man

Relative speed in the opposite direction = Speed of train + Speed of other train

Time to overtake = Distance / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the train be x km/h.

Relative speed with respect to man = x - 8 km/h

Distance covered = 280 m = 0.28 km

⇒ Time taken to overtake man = 16 seconds = 16/3600 hours

⇒ 16/3600 = 0.28 / (x - 8)

⇒ (x - 8) = 0.28 × (3600 / 16)

⇒ (x - 8) = 63

⇒ x = 63 + 8

⇒ x = 71 km/h

Now, relative speed with respect to the other train = 71 + 37 km/h = 108 km/h

Distance to be covered = 280 m + 380 m = 660 m = 0.66 km

⇒ Time taken to cross = 0.66 / 108 hours

⇒ Time taken to cross = 0.66 × (3600 / 108) seconds

⇒ Time taken to cross ≈ 22 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Which of the following CANNOT be explained using the phenomenon of scattering of light?

options.text: Red colour used for danger signals

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Twinkling of stars**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Twinkling of stars** cannot be explained using the phenomenon of scattering of light.
 
• Twinkling of stars is actually due to the **atmospheric refraction** of starlight.
 
• As starlight passes through the Earth's atmosphere, it is refracted (bent) multiple times, causing the light to change direction and intensity, making the stars appear to twinkle.
 
• Scattering of light, on the other hand, explains phenomena like the **blue colour of the sky** and the **reddening of the sun during sunrise and sunset**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scattering of light** is the process by which small particles and molecules in the atmosphere deflect light rays in different directions.
 
• The **blue colour of the sky** is due to Rayleigh scattering, where shorter wavelengths of light (blue) are scattered more than longer wavelengths (red).
 
• The **reddening of the sun** during sunrise and sunset occurs because the sun's light has to pass through a greater thickness of the Earth's atmosphere, scattering away the shorter blue wavelengths and allowing the longer red wavelengths to reach the observer.
 
• **Red colour used for danger signals** is because red light is scattered the least by air molecules, making it visible from a longer distance.

questions.question: There are 4 pipes attached to a tank. Two to fill the tank and the other two to transfer the water into a cistern. The first two pipes can fill the tank in 40 sec and 80 sec, respectively, when opened alone, while the last two can empty in 80 sec and 160 sec, respectively, when opened alone. If all the pipes are opened together, in how much time will the tank be filled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe 1 fills the tank in 40 sec

Pipe 2 fills the tank in 80 sec

Pipe 3 empties the tank in 80 sec

Pipe 4 empties the tank in 160 sec

**Formula used:**

Net rate of filling = (Rate of filling by Pipe 1 + Rate of filling by Pipe 2) - (Rate of emptying by Pipe 3 + Rate of emptying by Pipe 4)

**Calculation:**

Rate of filling by Pipe 1 = (1)/(40) tank/sec

Rate of filling by Pipe 2 = (1)/(80) tank/sec

Rate of emptying by Pipe 3 = (1)/(80) tank/sec

Rate of emptying by Pipe 4 = (1)/(160) tank/sec

⇒ Net rate of filling = (1)/(40) + (1)/(80) - (1)/(80) - (1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (1)/(40) - (1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (4 - 1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (3)/(160) tank/sec

Time to fill the tank = (1)/(frac{3){160}} sec

⇒ Time to fill the tank = (160)/(3) sec

⇒ Time to fill the tank = 53.33 sec

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: Find the area of a trapezium (in sq. unit) with parallel sides of length 3 unit and 5 unit and the shortest distance between its parallel sides is 6 unit.
questions.solution:

Length of the first parallel side (a) = 3 units

Length of the second parallel side (b) = 5 units

Shortest distance between the parallel sides (height, h) = 6 units

Area of a trapezium = dfrac{1}{2} times (a + b) times h

questions.question: In ΔABC, DE || AC, where D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively. If BD = 4 cm and AD = 2√2 cm, then what is the ratio of the area of ΔBDE to the trapezium ADEC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, DE || AC, where D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively.

BD = 4 cm

AD = 2√2 cm

**Formula used:**

Using the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales theorem), if a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle intersecting the other two sides, then it divides those sides in the same ratio.

Area ratio of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

**Calculation:**

Let AD = x, BD = y

Given: x = 2√2, y = 4

AB = AD + BD = 2√2 + 4

Since DE || AC, triangles ΔBDE and ΔBAC are similar.

Therefore, the ratio of their areas is the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of sides = BD / AB

⇒ Ratio of sides = 4 / (2√2 + 4)

⇒ Ratio of areas = (4 / (2√2 + 4))²

⇒ Ratio of areas = 16 / (2√2 + 4)²

⇒ Ratio of areas = 16 / (8 + 16√2 + 16)

⇒ Ratio of areas = 16 / (24 + 16√2)

⇒ Ratio of areas = 16 / 8(3 + 2√2)

⇒ Ratio of areas = 2 / (3 + 2√2)

⇒ area of trapezium = area of ΔBAC - area of ΔBDE

⇒ area of trapezium(ADEC) = (3 + 2√2) - 2 = 1 + 2√2

⇒ The ratio of the area of ΔBDE to the trapezium ADEC is 2 : (1 + 2√2)

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

• The Commission also works in coordination with state human rights commissions to ensure the protection and promotion of human rights across the country.

questions.question: When magnetic field is acting towards north and current is moving in east to west direction through a conductor, then the conductor will move ______ direction
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**in the downward**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a magnetic field is acting towards the north and the current is moving from east to west through a conductor, the conductor will experience a force due to the interaction of the magnetic field and the current.
 
• This phenomenon is explained by the **Fleming's Left-Hand Rule**, which helps determine the direction of the force acting on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.
 
• According to Fleming's Left-Hand Rule, if you align your left hand with the thumb pointing in the direction of the current (east to west), the forefinger pointing in the direction of the magnetic field (north), then the middle finger will point in the direction of the force (downward).
 
• Therefore, the conductor will move in the **downward direction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fleming's Left-Hand Rule** is a visual mnemonic used in physics to predict the direction of the force exerted on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.
 
• The rule states that if you hold your left hand with the thumb, forefinger, and middle finger mutually perpendicular to each other, with the thumb pointing in the direction of the current, the forefinger in the direction of the magnetic field, the middle finger will point in the direction of the force or motion.
 
• This principle is crucial in the functioning of electric motors, where the interaction between the magnetic field and the current produces motion.
 
• Understanding the direction of forces in magnetic fields is essential for designing and operating various electrical devices and systems.
